Replace test_claude_remaining_cap_refusal_is_not_a_model_turn with a test showing the floor check stops before the review call, with no extra FakeLLM request.
Keep the parts the reviewer accepted: the partial NO-GO return after at least one scorable review, and the record_go refusal of incomplete reports via _is_complete_go_grade.
Commit the harness fix first, then execute the harness exactly once from committed code, so produced_at_sha matches head. Never resume or stitch together an earlier journaled run.
In run.md, state plainly that earlier invocations spent money off-ledger: two refused calls journaled at usd 0.0 after ~0.1 remained. The operator must see the real cost.
